title: Iran Says Agreement on Hormuz Shipping Reached With Oman
title_cn: 伊朗称与阿曼达成霍尔木兹航运协议
summary: Iran said it had reached an agreement with Oman on a proposed route for shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a potential step toward a reopening of the critical waterway for energy supplies.
